Interface LogProperty.Result<T>

Type Parameters:
T - property type.
All Superinterfaces:
LogProperty.PropertyValue<T>, Supplier<LogProperty.Result<T>>
All Known Subinterfaces:
LogProperty.RequiredResult<T>, LogProperty.Result.Success<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
LogProperty.Result.Error, LogProperty.Result.Missing, LogProperty.Result.Success.PropertySuccess, LogProperty.Result.Success.ValueSuccess

public static sealed interface LogProperty.Result<T> extends LogProperty.PropertyValue<T> permits LogProperty.Result.Missing<T>, LogProperty.RequiredResult<T>
The result of a property fetched from properties.
